_rule: The business functions a company rents SaaS for, and the estate organ that replaces each — claimed only where the organ covers the function, with what it covers and what it does not, read from the organ's own page. An organ's maturity is never written here: it is the ladder's verdict from what GitHub's runners did (registry/tier-evidence.json, generated by tools/tiers.mjs). byok: true means the organ ships an optional bring-your-own-key route to a cloud model (off by default); a deployment that promises no data leaves the building switches it off.

functions.label: CRM — contacts, companies, deals and pipeline, activities, sales forecast
gaps: records shared live across a team — each browser keeps its own data today, so shared records on the company's own mesh are the hardening work
connectors to the bank's own systems

functions.label: Finance ledger — chart of accounts, journals, trial balance, P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, VAT, period close
covers: double-entry journals on a UK chart of accounts
trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet, cash-flow statement
gaps: accounts payable and receivable workflows at bank scale
books shared live across the finance team

functions.label: HR — employee records, contracts, absence, holiday, performance
covers: contracts and the s.1 Employment Rights Act 1996 written statement
absence, sickness, fit notes and the Bradford Factor
gaps: payroll — the estate has no payroll run engine
records shared live across the HR team

functions.label: Customer-service ticketing — queues, SLAs, the agent workspace
functions.why: No estate organ runs a ticket queue yet. fallfloor triages tickets and drafts replies on the company's own laptops; the ticketing system itself stays.

functions.label: E-signature — a signing ceremony for customers and counterparties
functions.why: fallsignature signs and verifies content (Ed25519) but runs no signing ceremony for counterparties, so it does not replace an e-signature service.

functions.label: Payroll — running pay, PAYE and RTI submissions
functions.why: The estate has no payroll run engine.
